title: elymus russellii
intro: Elymus russellii, commonly known as Russell's wild rye or Wild Rye, is a perennial grass native to North America. This plant has been used to provide relief from various health issues due to its health benefits, which include treating digestive problems, reducing inflammation, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as asthma. The therapeutic actions of Elymus russellii include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating muscle spasms, reducing swelling, and loosening mucus in the lungs. The bioactive constituents present in Elymus russellii include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
